verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage documents its own background automation: ongoing customer monitoring configurable per customer via API, and agentic workflows (Customer Screening/Ongoing Monitoring and Transaction Monitoring agents) that auto-remediate level 1 alerts and auto-escalate high-risk cases. Workflow-completion webhooks and async/batch screening support unattended operation. However, the agent evidence is thin marketing copy, the automations are fixed-purpose compliance agents rather than user-built ones, and Starter Plan agent configurations cannot be customized. Missing for 10: documentation of how users configure or define their own autonomous automations (triggers, schedules, rules), detail on agent configurability beyond the Starter Plan limit, independent or hands-on corroboration that the agents run autonomously as claimed.
